title: Match build, position and alleles

blocks.what_we_do: Audit shared variant identities before projection.
blocks.why: A shared rsID alone does not establish a match. Confirm the assembly, chromosome, coordinate and allele pair. GSA-style names have been changed at 4.5 to position-and-allele IDs. A swapped allele order can be compatible, but a mismatched pair or unresolved strand cannot be accepted blindly. Projection uses the named allele in each loading, not the order of rows in two files.
blocks.you_need: The common list from 5.2 and both PVAR tables.
blocks.command:
```{r s5-3}
common <- readLines(guided_path(cfg, "5.2", "common.txt"))
study <- guided_table(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "4.6"), ".pvar"))
reference <- file.path(cfg$data_dir, "pca_reference", "ref1000g_grch38")
ref <- guided_table(paste0(reference, ".pvar"))
a <- match(common, study$ID); b <- match(common, ref$ID)
pair <- function(a, b) ifelse(a < b, paste0(a, b), paste0(b, a))
stopifnot(all(sub("^chr", "", study$CHROM[a]) == sub("^chr", "", ref$CHROM[b])),
  all(study$POS[a] == ref$POS[b]), all(pair(study$REF[a], study$ALT[a]) == pair(ref$REF[b], ref$ALT[b])))
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

Not applicable: no PLINK operation is needed for this R-only or laboratory step. The R chunk is the complete command; PLINK cannot perform a laboratory measurement.

R reads or calculates the displayed values without changing the genotype files.
blocks.expected_result:
All 48,614 shared IDs agree on chromosome, GRCh38 position and allele pair. This checks compatibility between the supplied files; it is not independent validation against a genomic FASTA.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks and instructor reference counts passed on Windows.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
Is it safe to match only by row position if both PVAR files contain 48,614 rows?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

No. Match explicit IDs and verify position/alleles.

</details>
blocks.files_created: None; a mismatch stops execution before projection.
